# Drama League Award for Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre

}}
The Drama League Award for Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theater is a theater award presented annually since 1985 by The Drama League for "performers, composers, lyricists, choreographers, and directors whose careers have defined the utmost standard of excellence in musicals."
